name: Trae (ByteDance)
invoke: reference the mps-<role> rule, or paste `mps agents show <role>` into a new chat
notes: Trae keeps project rules in .trae/rules/ (project_rules.md is the one it always loads). Roles are written beside it as separate rule files; whether your Trae version auto-loads every file in that directory or only project_rules.md is worth checking once.
